# aggregate.densify_healpix_aggregates { #healpyxel.aggregate.densify_healpix_aggregates }

```python
aggregate.densify_healpix_aggregates(
    agg_sparse_df,
    nside,
    healpix_col='healpix_id',
)
```

Densify aggregated DataFrame to include all HEALPix cells.

Expands a sparse aggregation result (only observed cells) to the full
HEALPix grid (all ``12 * nside²`` cells). Missing cells are filled with
NaN for numeric columns and None for others.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type         | Description                                                                       | Default        |
|---------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| agg_sparse_df | pd.DataFrame | Aggregated DataFrame with ``healpix_id`` as index (sparse — only observed cells). | _required_     |
| nside         | int          | HEALPix nside parameter.                                                          | _required_     |
| healpix_col   | str          | Name of the HEALPix ID column. Default: ``'healpix_id'``.                         | `'healpix_id'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                    |
|--------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | Densified DataFrame with RangeIndex ``[0, 12*nside²)`` as index, containing all HEALPix cells. |
